  "memo":"R03 holds because the card issuing country differs from the IP country and CVV failed. Card is the only adverse family; no other rule holds, and household exceptions are unnecessary. Section 5.3(a) therefore requires clear and prohibits further holding or adverse disposition. Legitimate use of a foreign-issued card is the strongest explanation after verification; stolen-card suspicion is weakened. No further check is needed."
